tujuan.pengantar: Setelah mempelajari materi ini, peserta mampu:

soal.teks: Identify the sentence that is grammatically correct.

opsi.A: The inspection reports from the regional offices was reviewed on Tuesday before the weekly briefing.
opsi.B: The inspection reports from the regional offices were reviewed at Tuesday before the weekly briefing.
opsi.C: The inspection reports from the regional offices were reviewed on Tuesday before the weekly briefing.
opsi.D: The inspection reports from the regional offices were reviewed in Tuesday before the weekly briefing.
opsi.E: The inspection reports from the regional offices was reviewed at Tuesday before the weekly briefing.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Subject-verb agreement dan preposisi waktu
**Kata Kunci:** reports, from the regional offices, Tuesday
Reports adalah inti subjek jamak, sehingga pasangan yang tepat adalah were reviewed. Nama hari didahului on dalam konteks ini. Frasa from the regional offices hanya menerangkan reports.
Alasan opsi salah
A. Was tidak sesuai dengan reports.
B. At tidak tepat sebelum Tuesday.
D. In tidak tepat sebelum Tuesday.
E. Was tidak sesuai dengan reports dan at tidak tepat sebelum Tuesday.
Coret sementara frasa from the regional offices. Cek reports → were dan Tuesday → on secara terpisah.

soal.teks: Identify the sentence that is grammatically correct.

opsi.A: All refund requests must processed by the finance team before the end of the month.
opsi.B: All refund requests must be process by the finance team before the end of the month.
opsi.C: All refund requests must been processed by the finance team before the end of the month.
opsi.D: All refund requests must being processed by the finance team before the end of the month.
opsi.E: All refund requests must be processed by the finance team before the end of the month.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Passive dengan modal
**Kata Kunci:** refund requests, must, by the finance team

Refund requests menerima tindakan, sedangkan the finance team adalah pelakunya. Setelah must, gunakan be dalam bentuk dasar, diikuti V3 processed. Rangkaian must be processed menyampaikan kewajiban memproses permintaan pengembalian dana.
Alasan opsi salah
A. Processed tidak dapat langsung mengikuti must dalam konstruksi pasif.
B. Process adalah V1. Passive membutuhkan V3 setelah be.
C. Been tidak dapat langsung mengikuti must.
D. Being tidak dapat langsung mengikuti must.
Tandai penerima tindakan dan cari urutan modal → be → V3.

soal.teks: Identify the sentence that is grammatically correct.

opsi.A: The coordinator explained why was the training session postponed during the briefing with the regional operations team.
opsi.B: The coordinator explained why the training session was postponed during the briefing with the regional operations team.
opsi.C: The coordinator explained why the training session were postponed during the briefing with the regional operations team.
opsi.D: The coordinator explained why the training session was postpone during the briefing with the regional operations team.
opsi.E: The coordinator explained why the training session did postponed during the briefing with the regional operations team.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Urutan noun clause dan passive
**Kata Kunci:** explained why, the training session
Klausa setelah explained menjelaskan alasan penundaan. Susun why, kemudian subjek the training session, lalu was postponed. Session tunggal sesuai dengan was, dan postponed adalah V3.
Alasan opsi salah
A. Was the training session memakai inversi pertanyaan langsung.
C. Were tidak cocok dengan the training session yang tunggal.
D. Postpone adalah V1. Pola passive memerlukan postponed.
E. Did tidak membentuk passive, dan bentuk setelah did harus V1.
Setelah explained why, cari subjek sebelum kata kerja bantu. Cek be + V3 jika subjek menerima tindakan.
